# Production-launch blockers, by owner

**Generated by `_build/build-review-pack.js` on 15 September 2026.** Do not
hand-edit — rerun it, or it drifts from what actually ships.

> **What the automated controls do and do not do**

```text
Automated content and build controls help enforce approved copy, structural
requirements, placeholder handling, and selected prohibited phrases. They do
not independently verify substantiation, product availability, legal compliance,
privacy compliance, licensing requirements, testimonial permissions, or
state-specific mortgage-advertising obligations.
```

> A passing build is not a compliance review and must not be reported as one.

---


Nothing in this list is a code defect, and nothing in the build can close any
of it. The DFW suite stays staging/noindex until these are resolved by their
owners through the appropriate process.

Status labels are the six in §7.2 of the 15 September owner response.

| GA4 coverage gap on the Austin SPA | **CORRECTED 18 September 2026.** This row previously read "no GA4 or GTM container is installed" and that was wrong: GA4 property G-2LMXT6BVCY is loaded by a gtag snippet on 25 of the 26 pages and has been receiving these events. What is actually outstanding is narrower and was hidden by the wrong statement. (1) The Austin SPA shell at /index.html has the Meta Pixel but no gtag snippet, so the Austin home page and every React-rendered Austin route is unmeasured in GA4. (2) No GTM container exists, so the dataLayer push is consumed by nothing — which is a choice, not a defect, since gtag is wired directly. Confirm whether DFW should report into the same property or its own before production. | Launch dependency |
